evidence.quote: Leadership & Origin Story Altss was founded in 2025 by Dawid Siekiera , formerly a General Partner at Infinium Venture Studio. While raising capital, Dawid experienced firsthand the inefficiencies of static LP databases: outdated contacts missed allocator moves limited transparency into family-office activity Frustrated by those gaps, he built Altss to solve his own fundraising problem — creating a system that combines OSINT and social listening to capture allocator activity as it becomes publicly observable. His experience as both GP and founder informs Altss' mission: giving capital-raisers the tools he wished he had. https://www.linkedin.com/in/dsiekiera/
